name: sticker-drawer
title: Sticker Drawer
description: Edge-anchored panel on the same Radix Dialog base as StickerDialog, so the focus trap, scroll lock, escape handling and aria wiring are real. Anchors to any of the four sides, slides from the edge it is anchored to, and carries the die-cut edge on the side facing the content only. Sizes sm to lg plus a full-bleed full.
